programme.title: You’re So Cupid
programme.desc: Fraternal twin sisters Emma and Lilly are as different as night and day but both have an insatiable desire to play matchmaker. Why? Because their father is actually Cupid! Life gets complicated when they discover they're in love with the same guy and they become bitter rivals as they try to win his affection. But can Emma and Lily overcome their problems and use their matchmaking skills to bring their divorcing parents back together?

programme.title: Valentine’s Town
programme.desc: Working for a popular dating app, Jude heads up the company’s plan to build a tacky, love themed resort in Arrowheart, his hometown. Standing in their way is a local business owner, Melissa the Matchmaker, who has rallied the town’s residents against the resort.

programme.title: Storm Rider
programme.desc: Spoiled 18-year old Dani Fielding's world is turned upside down when her father gets arrested for securities fraud. She has to leave her cushy home and loses her prize horse to stay with her gruff uncle, Sam. As Dani and her uncle struggle to bond, she's given an orphaned colt that is a different type of horse than she is used to training. Dani pours her affection into 'Stormy' and through him learns what's missing in her unsettled life.

programme.title: The Wedding Contest
